name: Agent Context
description: Render the exact L3 input (messages + tools + model) an agent would receive on a fresh transition, as pretty-printed JSON. Includes system prompt, context entries, harness tools (with typed schemas when outputs is set), and base tools. Pass an optional task to see the complete first-iteration message vector including the synthesised goal. Pass an optional sessionId to include that session's conversation — prior turns and tool-failure diagnostics — exactly as a live transition on the session would see it.

task.description: Optional task input — if provided, a goal user message is synthesised and appended to the messages, showing the complete first-iteration context

sessionId.description: Optional session id (hex) — if provided, the session's conversation (prior turns, tool-failure diagnostics) is rendered into the context, mirroring a live transition on that session

output.description: Pretty-printed JSON of the L3 input: {messages, tools, model}
